issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按 md 猜成 20f，改版前视频只有开场 hold，字内漂移和放大接管都没演到
字内透出的 dashboard 大多是白卡和浅底，SCALE 读成普通白字，“字是窗口”的感觉很弱
接管层从 endT 0.25 就开始半透明淡入，中段在深底上叠出一层灰纱；线性插值的 1→26 放大先慢后猛地一胀
底部的 TEXT AS MASK 是调试占位；#2f2f2f 平灰底；字在第 0 帧硬切出现；漂移从静止瞬间跳到匀速
changes: 导出 TEXT_AS_MASK_DURATION = 150（hold 20f + 漂移 80f + 放大接管 30f + 静止 20f）
字内 dashboard 放大到 1.4 倍，叠一层靛→紫 multiply 色调（接管前淡出）；字形加一圈 1.5px 内发丝高光，读作玻璃窗口的边
放大改为对数插值 26^e，每帧放大比例恒定，视觉上匀速冲进字里；接管层推迟到 endT 0.62–0.9 才淡入，去掉中段灰纱
漂移两端轻缓（bezier(0.3,0,0.7,1)），末端零速接上放大；字 14f 浮现（0.97→1）
暗场换成带色相的柔光深底，字后有极淡的强调色地光，加颗粒（接管后撤掉）；调试占位换成副题 ONE WORKSPACE FOR EVERY TEAM
issuesEn: No exported duration constant: the workbench guessed 20f from the md, so the before video shows only the opening hold, with no in-letter drift and no zoom takeover
The dashboard seen through the letters was mostly white cards on a light canvas, so SCALE read as plain white type and the letters-as-windows idea barely came through
The takeover layer started fading in at endT 0.25, laying a translucent gray veil over the dark field mid-move; the linearly interpolated 1→26 zoom started slow, then ballooned
TEXT AS MASK at the bottom was a debug placeholder; flat #2f2f2f background; the word hard-cut in on frame 0; the drift jumped from rest straight to constant speed
changesEn: Exported TEXT_AS_MASK_DURATION = 150 (20f hold + 80f drift + 30f zoom takeover + 20f rest)
The in-letter dashboard is scaled 1.4x with an indigo-to-violet multiply tint (faded out before takeover); the glyphs get a 1.5px inner hairline highlight that reads as the edge of a glass window

The zoom now interpolates logarithmically (26^e) for a constant per-frame zoom ratio, so the push into the letter feels even; the takeover layer is delayed to endT 0.62–0.9, removing the mid-move gray veil
The drift eases at both ends (bezier(0.3,0,0.7,1)) and hands off to the zoom at zero velocity; the word fades in over 14f (0.97→1)

The dark field is now a hued soft-light backdrop with a faint accent glow behind the word and grain (removed after takeover); the debug placeholder is replaced by the subtitle ONE WORKSPACE FOR EVERY TEAM
